{{Quote|Oh, no&ndash;|The bounty hunter assistant's final words|<ref name="Shadows of the Empire 4">[[Shadows of the Empire 2|''Shadows of the Empire'' 2]]</ref>}}
A [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] '''assistant''' worked with the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Bossk/Legends|Bossk]] and a team of several other hunters, in an unsuccessful bid to steal the [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]]-frozen [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] from the bounty hunter [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3.5 ABY]]. Fett turned the tables on Bossk after [[Death/Legends|killing]] many of the hunters and sending their corpses in a [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] to Bossk's [[Hound's Tooth/Legends|ship]]. The assistant, believing the shuttle to contain Solo's frozen body, was killed when the shuttle exploded upon reaching Bossk's ship, foiling the Trandoshan's plans.
